title: Klint Kubiak: The Coach Keeping Secrets and Winning in the NFL
seoTitle: Klint Kubiak: The Secretive NFL Coach Winning Games
subtitle: How the Raiders coach's reserved approach is drawing the attention of fans and the media
excerpt: Klint Kubiak, Las Vegas Raiders coach, stands out for his extreme reservation of information and good results in the season's early rounds, generating.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the opening weeks of the 2025 season, the Las Vegas Raiders have been collecting victories while simultaneously sparking curiosity by adopting an almost non-existent communication style. The fact that head coach Klint Kubiak keeps game plans on paper and destroys documents after each game has been cited as one of the reasons for the growing attention.

Klint Kubiak's "buttoned up" style

Since the start of the campaign, the coach has been described as extremely organized and prepared. In an interview on the Raider Nation Radio show, host JT the Brick emphasized that "the head coach is buttoned up. That means his assistants are buttoned up, too." This posture prevents information from leaking to opponents or the media.

Extreme information security measures

According to Jori Epstein's column in Yahoo Sports, while some teams keep signals in online documents, Kubiak, during his time as the Seahawks' offensive coordinator, limited weekly plans to physical copies that were shredded at the end of each game. The coach does not use "signals Google Doc" like other franchises, reinforcing confidentiality.

Results that validate the strategy

The Raiders remain undefeated after three rounds, combining on-field efficiency with sparse interviews. Kubiak's press conferences have been compared to the silence that characterized the former New England Patriots under Bill Belichick, focusing more on team performance than public statements.

Roster decisions and preparation for the game against the Chiefs

In Week 4, Kubiak ruled out safety Jackson Powers-Johnson with a groin injury, according to the injury report released by the team. The coach also commented on the return of rookie Treydan Stukes, penalty containment, and final preparations to face the Kansas City Chiefs, highlighting the importance of maintaining tactical discipline.

Impact on upcoming games

With the defense led by Nakobe Dean and Quay Walker, and the offense relying on quarterback Kirk Cousins, the Raiders look to maintain their competitive edge. Kubiak's approach of limiting the disclosure of strategic details aims to prevent opponents like the Chiefs' Andy Reid from anticipating plays, keeping the team prepared for divisional challenges.

As the season progresses, the combination of positive results and the policy of secrecy continues to generate interest among fans and analysts, consolidating Klint Kubiak as one of the most closely watched coaches in the NFL.

With information from Raiders Beat, Raiders.com, Arrowhead Pride.
